# Capture provenance

`macos-multiple-responders.txt` derives from the user-provided macOS traceroute
capture reported on 2026-10-29. Every IP address was consistently replaced with
an RFC 5737 address. Line boundaries, indentation, RTTs, timeout markers and
header parameters were preserved. No probes were sent to produce this fixture.
The original `trace.txt` remains local and is not committed.
